evidence: M-O s.v. card: dealer, from Vives 1540
terms.comment: Lewis & Short has it, in the general sense “distributer”, from Apuleius only (post-classical); Vives uses it of the dealer, with chartās distribuere, “deal” (see deal).

phrases.english: You’ve got one more than you should (to the dealer).
Shuffle them all and deal again.

sources: Lewis & Short: distributor · Lewis & Short: distributrix
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. card: dealer.
Juan Luis Vives, Exercitātiō linguae Latīnae (1540), as Morgan–Owens quotes it; Vives from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-vives).
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 301.
